Definition: Kolajah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah names Ahab the son of Kolaiah, a false prophet to be slain before the exiles' eyes, and Nehemiah lists Pedaiah the son of Kolaiah among the sons of Benjamin. Two Kolaiahs, one the father of a liar and one the father of a citizen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe two men can share a name and share nothing else, and God keeps each Kolaiah in his own verse.
RelatedPeople: Kolaiah, Son of Maaseiah; Pedaiah, Son of Kolaiah; Ahab, Son of Kolaiah
